versions.content: If the ISignal . TransformationISignalProps . DataPro- totypeTransformationProps . networkRepresentationProps is not defined for a primitive element of a transformed ISignal, the RTE of the transmitting ECU shall perform the conversion of that primitive element based on the baseType specified at the ImplementationDataType used by the PPortPrototype . The converted data shall be passed to the first transformer in the chain.
